_source: Generic exercise names with original short descriptions written for this app.

exercises.name: Bench press (barbell)
exercises.d: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to mid-chest and press up.

exercises.name: Incline bench press (barbell)
exercises.d: Bench at 30–45°. Lower to upper chest, press up.

exercises.name: Decline bench press (barbell)
exercises.d: Head-down bench angle; bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.d: Shoulder-width grip, elbows tucked, bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Bench press (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Flat bench, dumbbells lowered beside the chest and pressed together.

exercises.name: Incline press (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Incline bench, press dumbbells over the upper chest.

exercises.name: Chest fly (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Soft elbows, open arms wide and hug back together.

exercises.name: Cable crossover
exercises.d: Pull handles from high pulleys down and across the body.

exercises.name: Chest press (machine)
exercises.d: Seated press with a fixed path; good for controlled volume.

exercises.name: Pec deck
exercises.d: Seated machine fly; squeeze the pads together.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.d: Rigid plank, lower chest to the floor and push back up.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.d: On parallel bars, lean slightly forward, lower and press up.

exercises.name: Deadlift (barbell)
exercises.d: Hinge and lift the bar from the floor to standing, bar close to the legs.

exercises.name: Bent-over row (barbell)
exercises.d: Hinge forward and row the bar to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
exercises.d: Strict row from a dead stop on the floor each rep.

exercises.name: One-arm row (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Hand and knee on a bench, row the dumbbell to the hip.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.d: Chest on an incline bench, row without using momentum.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.d: Straddle a landmine bar and row the handle to the chest.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.d: Overhand grip, pull until the chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.d: Underhand grip, pull chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.d: Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows driving down.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.d: Tall chest, row the handle to the stomach.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.d: Arms long, sweep the bar from overhead to the thighs.

exercises.name: Row (machine)
exercises.d: Seated row on a plate or selectorised machine.

exercises.name: Rack pull
exercises.d: Partial deadlift from pins at knee height.

exercises.name: Back extension
exercises.d: On a hyperextension bench, hinge down and raise to neutral.

exercises.name: Shrug (barbell)
exercises.d: Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears.

exercises.name: Shrug (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Dumbbells at the sides, elevate the shoulders.

exercises.name: Overhead press (barbell)
exercises.d: Standing, press the bar from the collarbones to lockout overhead.

exercises.name: Shoulder press (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Seated, press dumbbells from shoulder height overhead.

exercises.name: Shoulder press (machine)
exercises.d: Fixed-path overhead press.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.d: Start palms facing you and rotate out as you press.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.d: Press the end of a landmine bar up and forward.

exercises.name: Lateral raise (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Lateral raise (cable)
exercises.d: Single-arm raise from a low pulley across the body.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.d: Raise the weight in front to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Rear delt fly (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Hinged forward, open the arms out to the sides.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.d: Face the pec deck and sweep the handles back.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.d: Rope at face height, pull apart toward the ears.

exercises.name: Upright row
exercises.d: Pull the bar up the body to lower-chest height.

exercises.name: Curl (barbell)
exercises.d: Elbows pinned, curl the bar to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Curl (EZ bar)
exercises.d: Angled grip curl, easier on the wrists.

exercises.name: Curl (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Alternate or together, supinate as you curl.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.d: Neutral grip curl, thumbs up.

exercises.name: Incline curl (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Lying back on an incline, arms hanging behind the body.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.d: Upper arms on a pad, curl through full range.

exercises.name: Curl (cable)
exercises.d: Curl from a low pulley for constant tension.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.d: Seated, elbow braced on the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.d: Elbows at the sides, push the bar or rope down to lockout.

exercises.name: Overhead extension (cable)
exercises.d: Facing away from the pulley, extend the rope overhead.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
exercises.d: Lying, lower the bar toward the forehead and extend.

exercises.name: Overhead extension (dumbbell)
exercises.d: One dumbbell held in both hands behind the head.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.d: Hands on a bench behind you, lower and press up.

exercises.name: Wrist curl
exercises.d: Forearms on the thighs, curl the wrists up.

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.d: Overhand grip curl.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.d: Walk tall holding heavy weights at the sides. Log distance as reps.

exercises.name: Squat (barbell)
exercises.d: Bar on the upper back, sit down between the hips and stand up.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.d: Bar on the front of the shoulders, upright torso.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.d: Hold one weight at the chest and squat deep.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.d: Lower the sled under control and press through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Hack squat (machine)
exercises.d: Shoulders under the pads, squat along the fixed track.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.d: Rear foot on a bench, drop the back knee toward the floor.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.d: Step forward into a lunge, alternating legs.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.d: Drive up onto a box through the front leg.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.d: Seated, straighten the knees against the pad.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.d: Stand inside a hex bar and lift with a more upright torso.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.d: Soft knees, push the hips back until the hamstrings stretch.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift (dumbbell)
exercises.d: Hip hinge holding dumbbells in front of the thighs.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.d: Face down, curl the pad toward the glutes.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.d: Seated, pull the pad down and under.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
exercises.d: Ankles anchored, lower the body forward slowly.

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.d: Bar on the back, hinge forward with a flat spine.

exercises.name: Hip thrust (barbell)
exercises.d: Upper back on a bench, drive the hips up under the bar.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.d: Lying on the floor, lift the hips and squeeze.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.d: Wide stance, hands inside the knees.

exercises.name: Glute kickback (cable)
exercises.d: Ankle strap on a low pulley, kick the leg back.

exercises.name: Hip abduction (machine)
exercises.d: Seated, push the knees out against the pads.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.d: Explosive hip hinge, swing the bell to chest height.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.d: Rise onto the toes through full range, pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.d: Bent-knee calf raise to bias the soleus.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.d: Hold a straight line on forearms and toes. Log seconds as reps.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.d: Hang from a bar and raise the legs without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.d: Kneeling, crunch the rope down toward the knees.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.d: Roll out as far as you can control and pull back.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.d: Curl the ribs toward the hips.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.d: Seated lean-back, rotate side to side.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.d: Press the handle out and resist rotation.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.d: On your back, extend opposite arm and leg while bracing.
